title: How to Build a Business with AI in 2026 — 5 Steps
caption:
You don't need a team. You need AI + one clear offer. 🤝

The exact 5-step playbook solo founders are running in 2026:

1️⃣ Pick ONE painful problem (not a niche — a pain)
2️⃣ Let AI do the 80% — research, copy, design, code
3️⃣ Productize before you scale
4️⃣ Sell it before you build it
5️⃣ Automate delivery, never trust

One founder, one offer, one system. That's the whole game. ⚡

Save this 📌 — you'll come back to it when you start building.
